_comment: Ford Mode 22 (enhanced) PIDs for the dashboard. ALL ENTRIES ARE UNVERIFIED community values (Torque Pro / UltraGauge forum posts for 2011-2017 F-150 6R80; TPMS: Torque Pro Ford extended PID lists, BCM 726). Edit Data\pids\ford-enhanced-pids.json to fix them: value = (raw * scale) + offset, raw = big-endian 'bytes' after 62 DID DID (two's complement if signed). 'map' turns a raw integer into a label. Read-only service 22 only.

pids.name: Transmission gear (GEAR_OSC)
pids.source: f150ecoboost.net 'custom PIDs for Torque' (221E12, equation A); raw-to-gear mapping is a guess, 10R80 values unknown

pids.name: Transmission gear actual (?)
pids.source: Placeholder DID suggested for 'gear actual'; no confirmed source. Disabled by default.

pids.name: Tire pressure LF
pids.source: Torque Pro community PIDs (2gfusions.net 'Torque App and Extended Ford PIDs'; focusrs.org Torque PID list; torque-bhp.com 'Custom PIDs for Ford F150 (2011 tested)' gives (A*256+B)/20 psi, about the same scale). Header 726 (BCM), equation (((256*A)+B)/3+22/3) kPa. Not confirmed on a 2015-2020 F-150.
